featured_reviews.name: Rudri Randeria
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently did a 12-day Europe trip planned by Wings. The overall itinerary was suggested by their team, and they were quite open to making changes based on our preferences, which we appreciated.

The positives — the visa process was very smooth, and all the tours they organized were well-managed and insightful. The local coordination was excellent, and we didn’t face any issues on that front. The hotels they recommended were also very comfortable, and our stays were hassle-free throughout.

That said, there were a few areas where our experience could have been better. When it came to flights, we often had to follow up and explore options ourselves, as the suggestions provided were quite limited. Unfortunately, our flights were impacted due to the Middle East situation, and for alternatives, we ended up managing bookings on our own as we couldn’t find suitable budget-friendly options through the team.

Similarly, for local car bookings, the options shared with us were on the higher side, so we chose not to go ahead with them. Once we reached, we realized there were several more affordable options available locally.

Overall, Wings did provide a well-structured package with all the necessary vouchers, which made things convenient during the trip. I would recommend doing a bit of your own research alongside, especially for flights and local transport, to make the most of the experience.

At Mall Road we had a great time at Glenary's, it's a must go for every tourist. Amazing bakery items and one should definitely try their pizza.
